kinds.description: A weathered lump of rock sits where a pad should be. Break it up with picks and haul the pieces away.
kinds.iconConcept: A lone rounded boulder with one flat cut face and a chipped notch in its crown.

kinds.description: The trunk is long dead and the roots still grip the pad. Fell it, split it, and the wood is yours.
kinds.iconConcept: A bare forked trunk with three snapped branches and a pale split at the base.

kinds.description: Someone else's landing ended here. Cut the hull apart for scrap before it blocks anything else.
kinds.iconConcept: A snapped hull fin canted on the ground, ragged edge up, with two rows of rivets.

kinds.description: A shelf of spore-heavy fungus has taken the pad. Burn it back and collect what the rot left behind.
kinds.iconConcept: A tilted stack of three mushroom shelves, each wider than the last, with spotted caps.

kinds.description: A spear of old ice has grown through the pad. Melt it carefully; the water is worth keeping.
kinds.iconConcept: A jagged ice spear leaning off the vertical, with a split foot and a small frozen splash around it.

kinds.description: Raw crystal has burst through the ground. Cut it free before the whole pad starts to hum.
kinds.iconConcept: A fan of five crystal shards of unequal height rising from one faceted base.

kinds.description: A plate of cooled magma has fused over the pad, still ticking as it shrinks. Break the crust and clear the slag.
kinds.iconConcept: A cracked dark slab with a glowing seam zigzagging corner to corner.

kinds.description: Space itself is torn here. Seal the scar with shielding alloy before it spreads under the next pad.
kinds.iconConcept: A ragged black rip in the ground with a violet lip and loose pebbles floating above it.
